message.content:
Mid-weight wool trench coat in charcoal grey, classic double-breasted cut, knee-length hem, matte finish fabric.
Slim-fit tailored trousers in deep black wool crepe, straight leg with a subtle break at the ankle, clean pressed lines.
Cashmere crew-neck sweater in midnight navy, fine gauge knit with a modest neckline, soft drape.
Oxford cloth button-down shirt in white, crisp point collar, chest pocket with a single button closure.
Leather dress shoes in black oxblood, cap-toe design with a low block heel and smooth leather upper.
Silk necktie in solid black, narrow cut for a modern silhouette, matte weave texture.
Silver wedding band on the left ring finger, polished finish, minimalist design.

This outfit honors the solemnity of the funeral while respecting the autumn chill, offering a respectful blend of formal structure and somber elegance. The charcoal trench and black trousers provide a unified, dark palette suitable for mourning, while the fine wool textures convey quiet dignity without appearing overly stiff. A white shirt adds a necessary touch of cleanliness and contrast, balanced by the deep navy knit which introduces warmth to the ensemble. Every element, from the tailored fit to the understated accessories, aligns with the traditions of a fourth-day burial in Eastern culture, presenting a look that is both respectful and personally composed.
